prose: A profile of David Gruber, marine biologist and founder of Project CETI, which uses AI and machine learning to try to decode sperm whale communication. The piece frames the project as either the most audacious scientific undertaking of our time or a beautiful fool's errand, and traces Gruber's path from a boy watching ants through many fields of biology. Only the opening was read, so the technical detail is not covered.
highlights: Project CETI uses AI to decode sperm whale communication.
Seen as audacious by some and a fool's errand by others.
Basis: the opening of the article was read.
